build-pinned-source-cmake.title: Build the exact official source tag with CMake
required_inputs: MPI and package dependencies selected for the intended styles
prerequisites: Review the exact package/style requirements before configuration.
Use the peeled commit b54f0e7b0fb0003d6cec2e53c3b222211f4915c0.
Do not assume auto-detected MPI, FFT, image, accelerator, or compression libraries.
version_notes: The source tag fixes LAMMPS 4Jul2026; package-manager builds may identify another release.
CMake creates lmp in the build directory for the minimal documented route.
scientific_checks: none; a successful build is only environment evidence

inspect-binary.title: Capture exact version, build configuration, and compiled styles
input_script_template: info styles atom styles pair styles fix styles compute styles dump
required_inputs: exact executable selected by the user
prerequisites: Do not infer packages from a filename.
Record MPI, FFT, accelerator, compiler, precision, packages, and styles needed by the intended input.
version_notes: LAMMPS identifies releases by dates.
The 4Jul2026 info command supports configuration and style categories; -help exits after printing compiled styles/options.
failure_modes: accelerator suffix silently changes precision or implementation
scientific_checks: none; capability listing does not validate a force field or trajectory

official-lj-melt-smoke.title: Run the pinned official three-dimensional LJ melt example as a smoke test
required_inputs: none beyond the exact script and binary
prerequisites: Use a fresh directory.
Confirm lj/cut and nve are present in -help.
Preserve the official script bytes or record every intentional change.
official-lj-melt-smoke.restart_checkpoint: The official example has no restart; do not use it as a restart test.
version_notes: Script source is examples/melt/in.melt at patch_4Jul2026.
Parallel layouts can diverge numerically even when the run is valid.
failure_modes: missing final step or Loop time
pre-existing output mixed with the smoke run
scientific_checks: This is a software smoke test only.
The tutorial density, temperature, cutoff, timestep default, seed, and 250 steps are not a project convergence protocol.

minimize-imported-system.title: Minimize an imported data-file system
input_script_template: thermo_style custom step atoms pe press vol lx ly lz
expected_outputs: minimization stop reason and final force/energy
prerequisites: Validate topology, charges, box, type mapping, coefficients, model units, and boundary conditions.
Remove overlaps only through a documented physical preparation route.
Use fix box/relax only when cell relaxation is intended and stress settings are justified.
minimize-imported-system.restart_checkpoint: write_restart preserves a binary state; write_data is the more portable structural/force-field handoff but may not preserve every external model dependency.
version_notes: Minimization tolerances use the selected LAMMPS unit style.
Some force-field coefficients and external files are not self-contained in restart/data files.
failure_modes: unphysical atom overlap or box collapse
scientific_checks: force and energy tolerances must be appropriate to the claim
verify the minimized basin is relevant rather than merely local

nve-production.title: Run an NVE production segment with explicit outputs and checkpoints
input_script_template: velocity <integration-group> create <temperature> <positive-seed> mom yes rot yes dist gaussian
thermo_style custom step time temp pe ke etotal press vol
dump traj all custom <validated-cadence> trajectory.lammpstrj id type x y z ix iy iz vx vy vz
prerequisites: Equilibrate by a separately declared protocol before production.
Integrate each mobile degree of freedom exactly once.
Remove the velocity create command for a continuation that must retain velocities.
nve-production.restart_checkpoint: Periodic restart plus final write_restart; bind every segment and use the same fix IDs/styles when state restoration requires them.
version_notes: fix nve performs integration without thermostatting.
Restart writes can alter neighbor rebuild timing and therefore round-off trajectory details.
scientific_checks: replica/seed sensitivity when the claim needs it

nvt-equilibration.title: Run an NVT equilibration segment
input_script_template: velocity <integration-group> create <start-temperature> <positive-seed> mom yes rot yes dist gaussian
thermo_style custom step time temp pe ke etotal press vol density
dump traj all custom <validated-cadence> trajectory.nvt.lammpstrj id type x y z ix iy iz vx vy vz
required_inputs: validated time step and damping time
positive seed for a new velocity assignment
prerequisites: Do not also apply fix nve to the same integrated group.
Use the correct temperature compute for constrained, rigid, biased, or flow systems.
Predeclare equilibration diagnostics and discard rule.
nvt-equilibration.restart_checkpoint: Reissue fix nvt with the same fix ID/style after read_restart to restore compatible stored state; do not recreate velocities on continuation.
version_notes: Tdamp is a time, not a timestep count; the official manual illustrates expressions such as $(100.0*dt) but this is not universal acceptance.
Thermostat-only fixes such as temp/berendsen do not integrate positions by themselves, unlike nvt.
failure_modes: Tdamp too small/large for the intended response
apparent equilibrium from an insufficient segment

npt-equilibration.title: Run an isotropic NPT equilibration segment
input_script_template: velocity <integration-group> create <start-temperature> <positive-seed> mom yes rot yes dist gaussian
thermo_style custom step time temp pe ke etotal press pxx pyy pzz vol density lx ly lz
dump traj all custom <validated-cadence> trajectory.npt.lammpstrj id type x y z ix iy iz vx vy vz
required_inputs: periodic box on every barostatted dimension
validated damping times and time step
prerequisites: Choose iso/aniso/tri and coupled dimensions from the physics and boundary conditions.
Do not barostat a nonperiodic dimension.
Do not also integrate the same group with fix nve.
npt-equilibration.restart_checkpoint: Reissue the same npt fix ID/style after read_restart; retain velocities and restored box state.
version_notes: Tdamp and Pdamp are time values in the selected units.
Cell fluctuations and conserved-quantity details depend on fix settings such as tchain, pchain, drag, and coupling.
failure_modes: pressure estimated from too short a run

continue-from-restart.title: Continue to a declared target timestep from the latest binary restart
input_script_template: thermo_style custom step time temp pe ke etotal press vol
dump traj all custom <validated-cadence> trajectory.continue.lammpstrj id type x y z ix iy iz vx vy vz
required_inputs: full list of non-stored commands and external model files
expected_outputs: messages confirming or discarding saved fix state
prerequisites: Bind the selected wildcard match to the largest timestep.
Do not issue velocity create for exact-state continuation.
Recreate fixes/computes before commands that can discard stored state.
Use the same fix/compute IDs when restoration depends on them.
continue-from-restart.restart_checkpoint: This recipe is the checkpoint route; binary files are expected only for the same executable/platform and are not archival portability evidence.
version_notes: read_restart stores units, atom style, box, timestep, many force styles/coefficients, and atoms, but not fixes, computes, variables, regions, neighbor, kspace, thermo, dump, or restart output commands.
Different processor layouts/settings and some fixes/pair styles can prevent trajectory-exact continuation.
scientific_checks: parent/child state hash and timestep continuity
thermo continuity with expected stochastic limitations
statistical equivalence when bitwise continuation is not supported

restart-inspect-convert.title: Inspect and convert a binary restart with the producing executable
required_inputs: the executable/platform expected to read it
external model files for later reuse
prerequisites: Hash the source restart before conversion.
Keep the original immutable.
Treat converted.data as incomplete until external potential/model and non-stored settings are rebound.
restart-inspect-convert.restart_checkpoint: Conversion improves portability but cannot recreate fixes, computes, output commands, all coefficients, or all external model provenance.
version_notes: The binary format is not designed for cross-version or cross-platform compatibility.
scientific_checks: compare atom count, types, box, coordinates, velocities, topology, and available coefficients
revalidate every model and unit convention before a new run

rerun-custom-dump.title: Recompute observables from a custom dump with rerun
input_script_template: rerun trajectory.lammpstrj first <first-step> last <last-step> every <stride> dump x y z ix iy iz
required_inputs: force field if energies/forces are recomputed
prerequisites: Prove frame/site/box identity and dump field semantics.
Use wrapped/unwrapped/scaled fields consistently.
Do not assume velocities, images, charges, or molecule IDs exist unless present.
rerun-custom-dump.restart_checkpoint: not a dynamics continuation; rerun reads snapshots and does not integrate a trajectory
version_notes: The pinned official examples/rerun/in.rerun uses first/last/every and explicit dump fields.
failure_modes: atom IDs/types do not match topology

rdf-analysis.title: Accumulate a radial distribution function during a run or rerun
input_script_template: fix rdfout all ave/time <sample-every> <repeat-count> <output-every> c_rdfcalc[*] file rdf.dat mode vector
required_inputs: bin count and maximum distance policy
prerequisites: Check whether the force cutoff is the intended RDF cutoff.
If using compute rdf cutoff beyond the force cutoff, configure communication consistently.
Account for special_bonds exclusions and group selection.
rdf-analysis.restart_checkpoint: fix ave/time accumulation is not written to binary restart files; segment outputs explicitly
version_notes: The official 4Jul2026 compute rdf manual shows the fix ave/time vector-output pattern.
failure_modes: nonuniform system interpreted with bulk normalization

msd-diffusion-analysis.title: Estimate diffusion from mean-squared displacement
input_script_template: thermo_style custom step time temp c_msdcalc[4] v_diffusion
required_inputs: equilibrated diffusive trajectory or live run
predeclared fit interval and sample cadence
expected_outputs: MSD time series in log or declared file
prerequisites: Issue compute msd at the intended reference time.
Use the same compute ID across a binary restart if stored reference positions must continue.
Do not use average yes for a diffusing system without a specific justified interpretation.
msd-diffusion-analysis.restart_checkpoint: compute msd stores reference coordinates through an internal fix; recreate the same compute ID/group before state-discarding commands after read_restart
version_notes: The official DIFFUSE/in.msd.2d example divides the slope by four for two dimensions; use 2d for d dimensions.
The exact value can depend on how often compute msd is evaluated when average yes is used.
failure_modes: ballistic or caged interval fitted as diffusion
scientific_checks: identify a stable long-time linear regime
vary fit window and sampling cadence

vacf-diffusion-analysis.title: Estimate diffusion from the velocity autocorrelation function
input_script_template: thermo_style custom step time temp c_vacfcalc[4] v_diffusion
prerequisites: Preserve velocities and units.
Remove the equilibration thermostat if the intended production ensemble requires it.
Choose a correlation duration long enough for the tail.
vacf-diffusion-analysis.restart_checkpoint: restarting changes correlation origins; treat segments explicitly unless a validated stateful protocol is used
version_notes: The official DIFFUSE/in.vacf.2d example uses a factor 0.5 for two dimensions.

colvars-umbrella-window.title: Run one explicitly configured Colvars umbrella window
input_script_template: fix Colvars all colvars colvars.window-<id>.inp output window-<id> seed <positive-seed>
thermo_style custom step time temp pe etotal f_Colvars
required_inputs: COLVARS package/style in the exact binary
versioned Colvars configuration defining the collective variable and harmonic restraint
prerequisites: Validate atom selections, periodic handling, units, reaction coordinate, restraint convention, thermostat coupling, and initialization for every window.
Use the official Colvars reference for the configuration file; this recipe does not fabricate its full syntax.
Predeclare window spacing, equilibration discard, overlap criterion, PMF estimator, and uncertainty method.
colvars-umbrella-window.restart_checkpoint: fix colvars stores state in LAMMPS binary restarts and text .colvars.state; recreate the same fix/configuration. A read_data continuation requires the state file through input or fix_modify load.
version_notes: The 4Jul2026 fix colvars interface includes output/input/unwrap/tstat/seed and exposes restraint energy as a global scalar.
Colvars configuration semantics are versioned independently from the LAMMPS command wrapper.
